text:
maria: Quick check — I'm iterating on the trace viewer drilldown copy and keyboard nav. Want to land small copy + a11y fixes before next sprint. Thoughts?

jon: I skimmed the Figma. main concerns: default stack trace density, and the export wording. 'Export trace' is vague.

lee: Agreed on export. Folks will expect either HAR, JSON bundle, or a Sentry link. Maybe split actions: 'Download bundle (JSON)' and 'Open in Sentry' ? :thinking_face:

anya: For keyboard navigation — can we make the frame list tabbable and support arrow keys + enter to expand? Right now tab goes through visual buttons only.

maria: Yep. Proposal: tabindex on each frame row, left/right to collapse/expand, Enter to open source link. Also add aria-labels like "Frame 3 of 12 — file foo.py — toggle details".

jon: For copy: current header says 'Stacktrace' — can we change to 'Stack trace (most recent call first)' ? Short and sets expectation.

lee: I worry about length. Maybe 'Stack trace — newest first' (shorter). Also monospaced font for frames, but ensure contrast against background.

anya: Accessibility nits: focus ring color is light blue on white — fails contrast. Recommend token: focus outline: 3px solid #005FCC OR use visible inset shadow.

maria: +1 on focus ring. Also we should add a keyboard shortcut cheat sheet on the trace page: small link 'Keyboard shortcuts' that opens a modal listing keys.

jon: Copy tweak for correlation IDs: current label 'trace_id' (snake_case) looks like raw telemetry. UX prefer 'Trace ID' and show a copy button with tooltip 'Copied trace id'.

lee: For export action, add small dropdown: 'Download bundle (JSON)', 'Download HAR', 'Copy trace link', 'Open in Sentry'. Default action should be copy link — that's what support usually asks for.

maria: UX question: should stack frames be collapsed by default for long traces? If we collapse, we can show a summary like '12 frames (3 app frames) — expand'.

anya: Yes collapse by default for >8 frames. Show app frames first and a 'Show full stack' button. Screen reader should announce total frames on load.

jon: Microcopy: change the trace export button label from 'Export' to 'Share / Export' so users understand it covers links and downloads.

lee: Implementation note: when we bundle JSON, include source map links if available. Also include a minimal schema doc in the bundle so external tools can parse.

maria: I'll update Figma with two variants: collapsed-by-default and expanded-by-default. Putting both in the same frame so PM/eng can pick. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/traces-ux-v2 :eyes:

dev-bot: deploy-preview created: https://redwood-inference.dev/pr/2384 — includes a11y fixes and export dropdown.

anya: Small wording suggestion for export modal: replace 'Include debug symbols' with 'Include source maps' — clearer for most users.

jon: One last nit — timestamp formatting in drilldown: drop milliseconds, use 'Mar 21, 2025 14:23:05 UTC' instead of epoch. Cleaner for non-dev stakeholders.

maria: Good call. Action items I note: 1) change copy to 'Trace ID' + copy tooltip, 2) export dropdown options + default to copy link, 3) collapsed-by-default behavior for long traces, 4) focus ring color fix + keyboard nav arrows, 5) update Figma and PR. I'll post the updated frames by EOD.

lee: I'll scope the export bundle schema and add source map flag.

jon: I'll run contrast tests and propose focus ring tokens.

anya: I'll write the a11y acceptance criteria for the ticket.

maria: Thanks team :heart: — we should be able to ship the copy + a11y fixes in the next patch release.
